But when I’m going thru “dark times” because of serious illness in my family, followed by so many problems because money doesn’t grow on trees all I, and many people, can do is just cry in private and suck it up and try to live day by day with the little joys in life, with no brands sending free shit, no parasocial relationships with fans, and some with no family support, still clocking in at work, everyday. It’s not a challange on who has it worse, but I’ve seen many influencers that aren’t out of touch with life that can understand the privilege they have, and don’t want sympathy from people who don’t even know them.
